additional_info.subject: RE: ID0465124-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP/R9 170002553] CU logs check CRM:03056000657
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0465124.
The ticket was opened to check an unsuccessful charging session today on charger
MP/R9 170002553.
I checked the logs, and the session failed because the user authenticated and then connected the wrong outlet:
As you can see, the user authenticated for ConnectodId: 2, which is DC2, but then he connected DC1, which is connectodId:1.
For your reference, this is the configuration from charger side:
The session of course failed, and the user did not try to authenticate or connect anymore.
Please let me know if you have further questions, otherwise I will proceed to close the ticket.
With kind regards,
